title: Rep. Luna Escalates to Formal Subpoena as Pentagon Misses UAP Video Deadline
detail: Rep. Anna Paulina Luna (R-FL), chairwoman of the House Oversight Task Force on the Declassification of Federal Secrets, confirmed to NewsNation that she is coordinating with House Oversight Committee Chairman James Comer to pursue a formal subpoena for the 46 classified UAP videos the Pentagon failed to deliver by her April 14 deadline. Luna's March 31, 2026 letter to Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth — which requested videos with whistleblower-provided titles such as 'Spherical UAP in clouds' — went unacknowledged until her office followed up directly. Luna stated: 'We are not waiting for a briefing.' The Pentagon, while stating AARO is 'working in close coordination with the White House,' has provided no videos, no timeline, and no formal acknowledgment of the missed deadline. With 21 days remaining until Trump's May 20 executive order 90-day milestone, the House Oversight Task Force's subpoena threat marks the most aggressive congressional enforcement action in the current disclosure push.
confidenceReason: Luna's statements and subpoena escalation confirmed by NewsNation reporting. Pentagon non-response to the April 14 deadline confirmed by multiple outlets since April 18.

media.caption: Rep. Luna confirms subpoena coordination with Chairman Comer after Pentagon misses 46-video deadline

title: Greer Announces May 8 National Press Club UAP Disclosure Event With Military Whistleblowers
detail: Dr. Steven Greer announced a '25th Anniversary Disclosure Event' at the National Press Club in Washington, D.C. on May 8, 2026 (3:00–4:30 PM), marking the anniversary of the original 2001 National Press Club disclosure conference. The event will feature first-hand whistleblower testimony from former military personnel, including a U.S. Army Green Beret who claims to have been taken to a facility in Indiana housing non-human artifacts and to have witnessed a man-made 'Tic Tac' craft. Greer announced he will also present policy recommendations for presidential executive actions and congressional initiatives. The announcement — confirmed by PR Newswire and the National Press Club event listing — is timed deliberately ahead of Trump's May 20 EO deadline. Note: Greer is a controversial figure in the UAP community; his events feature self-reported testimonies that have not been independently verified by AARO or congressional investigators.
confidenceReason: Event announcement confirmed by PR Newswire and National Press Club event listing. Whistleblower claims described in the announcement have not been independently verified.

media.caption: Greer announces 25th anniversary UAP disclosure event at National Press Club for May 8, 2026
